coastal.title: Hiker missing from B.C. gondola made call to 911 saying he's 'stuck on the mountain'
coastal.description: Search and rescue crews say a hiker who's been missing from the Squamish area since Sunday managed to briefly get through to 911 on Tuesday, but that searchers still haven't been able to find him.

kamloops.title: Ahead of municipal election, Kelowna mayor asks feds to shut down supervised consumption site
kamloops.description: The mayor of Kelowna, B.C., has written to the federal health minister asking for authorities to deny the renewal of a supervised consumption site operating in the city's downtown core. Mayor Tom Dyas's letter comes a little under two months before the municipal election in the city, in which he is running for re-election.

prince-george.title: Missing person found dead in Fraser River was killed, Prince George RCMP believe
prince-george.description: Julian Wich, 29, was reported missing on Jan. 2 and found dead six months later.
